cigarHint.hr: Gusto, desertno i polirano tijelo traži sporu punu cigaru; držite format dulji, a nikako agresivan nikotinski udar.
cigarHint.en: Dense, dessert-leaning, polished body wants a slow full cigar; keep the format longer, never an aggressive nicotine hit.

notes.hr: Referentni ultra-premium siping — gusto, slatko hrastovo tijelo. Traži punu, sporu cigaru; ne uz gin-stil botaniku.
notes.en: A reference ultra-premium sipper — dense, sweet oak body. Wants a full, slow cigar; not gin-style botanicals.

cigarHint.hr: Hrast, kakao i karamela traže srednje punu do punu cigaru; preslatki maduro lako preuzme večer pa ga držite pod kontrolom.
cigarHint.en: Oak, cocoa and caramel want a medium-full to full cigar; a sugary maduro easily takes over, so keep it in check.

notes.hr: Sipping añejo — hrast, vanilija i kakao nose maduro i puniji Habano. Sparivanje radi kad cigara ostane suha u finišu.
notes.en: A sipping añejo — oak, vanilla and cocoa carry maduro and a fuller Habano. The match holds when the cigar stays dry in the finish.

cigarHint.hr: Svježa agava i citrus drže Connecticut ili kraću Habano cigaru; papar u listu i papar u čaši pojačavaju se bez sudara.
cigarHint.en: Connecticut or a mild Habano — clean agave and citrus suit a light to medium cigar; leave a heavy maduro for another evening.

notes.hr: Referentni sipping blanco — čista agava i citrus. Uz laganu do srednju cigaru, ne uz maduro bombu.
notes.en: A reference sipping blanco — clean agave and citrus. With a light to medium cigar, not a maduro bomb.

cigarHint.hr: Agava još vodi riječ, ali hrast i vanilija već nose srednju Habano cigaru; drugi dim dolazi mekše nego uz čist blanco.
cigarHint.en: Agave still leads, but oak and vanilla already carry a medium Habano; the second puff arrives softer than with a straight blanco.

notes.hr: Most između agave i hrasta — klasičan spoj sa srednjom Habano / natural cigarom.
notes.en: A bridge between agave and oak — a classic match with a medium Habano / natural cigar.

cigarHint.hr: Habano / maduro — vanilija i hrast. Klasični añejo traži srednje punu cigaru koja drži hrast bez prevelike slatkoće.
cigarHint.en: Habano / maduro — vanilla and oak. A classic añejo wants a medium-full cigar that holds oak without too much sweetness.

notes.hr: Klasični añejo s više hrasta i začina; najbolje ide uz srednje punu cigaru koja ne gura previše slatkoće.
notes.en: A classic anejo with more oak and spice; best with a medium-full cigar that does not push too much sweetness.

cigarHint.hr: Agava još ostaje živa, ali hrast i vanilija već nose srednju cigaru; pustite da drugi dim dođe nakon prvog gutljaja.
cigarHint.en: Agave is still lively, but oak and vanilla already carry a medium cigar; let the second draw come after the first sip.

notes.hr: Duže odležavanje u bačvi nego mnogi reposado — više hrasta i začina, dobro uz srednje–punu cigaru.
notes.en: Longer barrel rest than many reposados — more oak and spice, good with a medium–full cigar.

name: Código 1530 AÑEJO Tequila 38% Vol. 0,7l u poklon kutiji

cigarHint.hr: Habano / maduro — vanilija i hrast. Hrast i kakao traže srednje punu cigaru koja ostaje suha u finišu.
cigarHint.en: Habano / maduro — vanilla and oak. Oak and cocoa want a medium-full cigar that stays dry in the finish.

notes.hr: Añejo s više vanilije i hrasta nego svježine traži srednje punu cigaru koja drži ritam bez agresivne slatkoće.
notes.en: An anejo with more vanilla and oak than freshness, suited to a medium-full cigar that keeps its rhythm without aggressive sweetness.

name: Código 1530 BARREL AÑEJO Tequila 44% Vol. 0,7l u poklon kutiji

cigarHint.hr: Habano / maduro — vanilija i hrast. Hrast i kakao traže srednje punu cigaru koja ostaje suha u finišu.
cigarHint.en: Habano / maduro — vanilla and oak. Oak and cocoa want a medium-full cigar that stays dry in the finish.

notes.hr: Jača bačva i viši alkohol traže puniju cigaru s paprom i drvom; sparivanje voli spor tempo i duži finiš.
notes.en: More barrel and higher alcohol call for a fuller cigar with pepper and wood; the pairing prefers a slow pace and a longer finish.

cigarHint.hr: Connecticut / blagi Habano — čista agava. Agava i citrus drže lakšu do srednju cigaru bez teškog završetka.
cigarHint.en: Connecticut / mild Habano — clean agave. Agave and citrus hold a light to medium cigar without a heavy finish.

notes.hr: Klasična herradurina agava — malo zemljanija i peprijastija od Don Julia. Dobro uz srednju cigaru.
notes.en: Classic Herradura agave — a touch earthier and pepperier than Don Julio. Good with a medium cigar.

name: Herradura Tequila AÑEJO 100% de Agave 40% Vol. 0,7l u poklon kutiji

cigarHint.hr: Habano / maduro — vanilija i hrast. Hrast i kakao traže srednje punu cigaru koja ostaje suha u finišu.
cigarHint.en: Habano / maduro — vanilla and oak. Oak and cocoa want a medium-full cigar that stays dry in the finish.

notes.hr: Klasični añejo s hrastom i kakaom voli maduro ili puniji Habano; cigara neka bude zaobljena, ne gruba.
notes.en: A classic anejo of oak and cocoa that likes maduro or a fuller Habano; the cigar should stay rounded, not rough.

name: Herradura Tequila ULTRA AÑEJO 100% de Agave 40% Vol. 0,7l

cigarHint.hr: Habano / maduro — vanilija i hrast. Hrast i kakao traže srednje punu cigaru koja ostaje suha u finišu.
cigarHint.en: Habano / maduro — vanilla and oak. Oak and cocoa want a medium-full cigar that stays dry in the finish.

notes.hr: Poliran, odležan profil s više hrasta nego svježine traži mirniju cigaru srednje do pune snage i uredan finiš.
notes.en: A polished, mature profile with more oak than freshness; it wants a calmer medium-full cigar and a tidy finish.

cigarHint.hr: Mekši reposado s medom i vanilijom traži srednju cigaru; hrast se lijepo veže kad omot ne gura previše kakaa.
cigarHint.en: A softer reposado with honey and vanilla wants a medium cigar; oak binds well when the wrapper does not push too much cocoa.

notes.hr: Mekši reposado s vanilijom i medom. Sparivanje sjeda uz srednje tijelo cigare, kad hrast ostane u pozadini a agava još diše.
notes.en: A softer reposado with vanilla and honey. It sits well with a medium-bodied cigar when oak stays behind and the agave still breathes.

cigarHint.hr: Slađi reposado i meka vanilija traže srednju cigaru koja ostaje elegantna; cijena boce je visoka, ali sparivanje ne mora biti teško.
cigarHint.en: A sweeter reposado and soft vanilla want a medium cigar that stays elegant; the bottle is pricey, but the match need not feel heavy.

notes.hr: Prepoznatljiva keramika i slađi reposado profil — dio cijene je boca; uz srednju, ne prejake cigare.
notes.en: Distinctive ceramics and a sweeter reposado profile — part of the price is the bottle; with a medium, not overly strong cigar.

cigarHint.hr: Mekši, desertniji añejo nosi maduro bez svađe, ali bolji je kada cigara zadrži papar i suhi kakao umjesto šećera.
cigarHint.en: A softer, dessert-leaning añejo carries maduro without conflict, but works best when the cigar keeps pepper and dry cocoa instead of sugar.

notes.hr: Mekši, desertniji añejo. Lako ide uz maduro, ali bolji je kad cigara zadrži papar i suhi kakao umjesto šećera.
notes.en: A softer, dessert-leaning añejo. It goes easily with maduro, but it is better when the cigar keeps pepper and dry cocoa instead of sugar.

name: Gran Patron Tequila PLATINUM Silver 100% de Agave 40% Vol. 0,7l u poklon kutiji

notes.hr: Glatki premium blanco — dobra ulazna točka za sparivanje s Connecticutom ili blagim Habano; slatkoća ostaje meka, ne gusta.
notes.en: A smooth premium blanco — a good entry with Connecticut or a mild Habano; the sweetness stays soft, not heavy.

notes.hr: Patrón Añejo odležava u malim bačvama bijelog hrasta. Hrast, vanilija i karamela nose srednje punu cigaru; držite finiš suhim.
notes.en: Patrón Añejo rests in small white-oak barrels. Oak, vanilla and caramel carry a medium-full cigar; keep the finish dry, not sugary.

cigarHint.hr: Agava još ostaje živa, ali hrast i vanilija već nose srednju cigaru; pustite da drugi dim dođe nakon prvog gutljaja.

notes.en: A popular, smooth reposado. It drinks easily with a medium evening cigar; let the first puff settle before the second sip.

cigarHint.hr: Corojo / oscura — dim uz dim. Gladak mezcal drži srednju cigaru; dim neka bude slojevit, ne sirupast.
cigarHint.en: Corojo / oscuro — smoke with smoke. A smooth mezcal holds a medium cigar; keep the smoke layered, not syrupy.

notes.hr: Casamigos mezcal u glatkom stilu. Sparivanje drži srednju cigaru; dim neka bude slojevit uz zemlju i papar, ne sirupast.
notes.en: Casamigos mezcal in a smoother style. It holds a medium cigar; keep the smoke layered with earth and pepper, not syrupy.

name: Arte Azul EXTRA AÑEJO 100% Agave Azul 35% Vol. 1l

cigarHint.hr: Maduro / oscuro — gusta večer. Gusto tijelo voli sporu punu cigaru, ali ne i slatki višak.

notes.hr: Dubok hrast, karamela i topliji finiš traže sporiju, puniju cigaru; slatkoća neka ostane u ravnoteži s paprom.
notes.en: Deep oak, caramel, and a warmer finish call for a slower, fuller cigar; keep the sweetness in balance with pepper.

notes.hr: Odležani slojevi karamele i hrasta nose puniju večernju cigaru; birajte profil koji ne gubi korak u finišu.

cigarHint.hr: Otvoren, pošten blanco nosi lakšu cigaru bez napora; citrus i papar rade najbolje kada je format kraći i življi.
cigarHint.en: An open, honest blanco carries a lighter cigar without strain; citrus and pepper work best when the format is shorter and livelier.
